name: – Ingeborg Ter Laak – After recital 4 – Am 18
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council suspending the application of the rules on the appointment of an authorised representative for extended producer responsibility for batteries and waste batteries and packaging and packaging waste
part_text: (4a) The suspension of the administrative requirement concerning the appointment of an authorised representative introduced by this Regulation should also be aimed at suspending obligations of producers with regards to extended producer responsibility in their entirety until the issues relating to administrative burdens have been resolved.
